items.title: How will Nepal verify those missing after the Bhotekoshi floods?
items.desc: The government has begun compiling an official list of people missing in the August 26 disaster. The process will determine who can be declared dead and whose families qualify for relief.

items.title: Nepal bans 47 immunosuppressant brands, doctors question move
items.desc: Department of Drug Administration has cited safety concerns but doctors say the move could disrupt supplies of life-saving medicines for transplant patients.

items.title: More than 1,200 farm animals lost in Budhigandaki floods
items.desc: The disaster also destroyed 34 livestock sheds and 12 pig pens, while veterinary teams treat rescued animals and deliver feed and medicines to affected areas.

items.title: Nepal arrests four medical operators amid deepening row with Malaysia over worker recruitment
items.desc: The arrests come as Malaysia moves to restrict recruitment to 25 approved agencies, despite Nepal’s foreign ministry urging a diplomatic solution to the dispute.

items.title: At least 33 killed, including 32 students, in Pakistan school roof collapse
items.desc: The collapse at a school in Peshawar killed 32 children aged seven to 14 and a female teacher, prompting calls for a probe and safety audits of educational institutions across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

items.title: Fire destroys 13 houses in Saptari, leaving nine families homeless
items.desc: Cash, food stocks, clothes and household essentials were reduced to ashes in a fire in Badgama, leaving families struggling to find shelter and meet their daily needs.

items.title: Government tells actor Imran Khan to leave country after participation in protests
items.desc: The actor, who holds an Overseas Citizen of India card, was ordered to leave by October 28 over his participation in protests demanding the chief election commissioner’s resignation.

items.title: Late-September rains cause Rs65.1 million damage to Kaligandaki Corridor
items.desc: Landslides and road subsidence have disrupted traffic, while building nine unfinished bridges along the corridor is estimated to cost Rs720 million.

items.title: Book Talk: Sara Shneiderman on understanding Nepal through its people
items.desc: Drawing on more than three decades of research, anthropologist Shneiderman reflects on Nepal’s political transformation, migration and the importance of listening to local communities.

items.title: Contractor builds 268-metre suspension bridge in a month after floods cut off communities
items.desc: Shailendra Raj Pyakurel tapped the construction industry’s own fund to build a vital crossing over the Trishuli river for Rs17.5 million, nearly half the government’s estimate.

items.title: Buying a goat for Dashain? Look for the green mark
items.desc: Veterinary teams have inspected 6,800 goats, 1,500 mountain goats, 100 buffaloes, and 41 tonnes of fish over three days. Healthy animals get green markings, and sick ones get red.

items.title: Dashain shopping is costing Nepali families more this year
items.desc: Nepal Rastra Bank’s consumer price index shows that food inflation has accelerated significantly from a year earlier.

items.title: Big projects, old disputes on agenda for PM Shah’s India visit
items.desc: Nepali and Indian officials have begun preparations for the trip, expected in the second half of November.

items.title: Chief ministers unite to press federal government on devolution
items.desc: Their two-day meeting ended Wednesday with an agreement to form a joint forum to push for greater provincial powers, fiscal autonomy, and a clearer division of responsibilities with the centre.

items.title: Deuba faction presses ahead with parallel Congress convention
items.desc: The rival camp has completed constituency conventions in 112 of 165 federal constituencies, but thousands of ward and local-level gatherings remain outstanding.

items.title: Hearing committee rejects two ambassadorial nominees, puts Japan pick on hold
items.desc: Despite vetting thousands, the government’s ambassadorial picks face scrutiny over harassment, financial irregularities and foreign residency.

items.title: Rights recommendations must move beyond compensation
items.desc: Compensation for 153 victims offers hope, but Nepal must act on its international commitments.

items.title: Disaster, royalty and revolution: What makes Nepal newsworthy?
items.desc: Stories from Nepal have become more common internationally in recent decades, although positive ones are rare.

items.title: How monitoring and evaluation framework masks failure
items.desc: A monitoring framework can count toilets built, but not whether people use them, they’re well located or work for women.

items.title: Father cannot afford last rites for son missing in Bhotekoshi floods
items.desc: Forty-seven days after 25-year-old Pradip Sapkota went missing, his family has yet to recover his body and is struggling to pay for his funeral rites.

items.title: Makawanpur begins process to declare 58 missing people dead
items.desc: Authorities have begun verifying the status of those missing since the August 26 Bhotekoshi floods under a special government procedure, with local units required to collect applications and check claims.

items.title: Army chief Sigdel returns from official UK visit
items.desc: General Sigdel met senior British military officials and honoured Nepali soldiers who won gold at an international military exercise.

items.title: A timber bridge reopens route to Upper Manang after three weeks
items.desc: A wooden deck laid over the steel girders of a submerged bridge has restored access for jeeps and motorcycles, but heavier vehicles remain barred.

items.title: India boat capsizes, drowning 13, mostly children
items.desc: Police are ​investigating the ​cause of the incident, regional police ​officer Subodh Kumar ​told Reuters on Wednesday, giving the tally of those ​rescued.

items.title: Relief helicopter gives Rasuwa farmers a route to market
items.desc: The WFP has flown around eight tonnes of vegetables from flood-isolated Aamachhodingmo to Bidur, helping growers salvage part of their harvest.

items.title: IMF urges members to stock up funds for low-income, vulnerable states
items.desc: The IMF this week flagged significant growth and financial stability risks from a potential end of the AI investment boom, ‌growing debt levels and a prolonged Middle East conflict. It forecast global growth at 3.1 percent for 2026.

items.title: Salyan villages have little heart for Dashain celebrations
items.desc: Dozens remain missing after the Bhotekoshi floods in Rasuwa, leaving families and neighbours across the district with little to celebrate this year.

items.title: India’s ‘cockroach’ movement leaders detained in jail for five days
items.desc: The arrests could fuel further protests over voter-list revisions that opposition parties say favour Modi’s BJP, allegations rejected by the election commission.

items.title: Parliamentary panel halts hearing on Malaysia ambassador nominee over complaints
items.desc: Lawmakers cite allegations of financial dealings, land irregularities and conflicts of interest; nominee Chudamani Kharel denies wrongdoing.

items.title: UML lawmaker resigns over Sudurpaschim budget
items.desc: Bir Bahadur Thapa quit after being denied an opportunity to speak during budget deliberations, while another UML lawmaker stayed away from the vote.
